summary: IDF forces in Gaza neutralized two terrorists who crossed the yellow line in separate incidents in southern and central Gaza, while Israeli forces eliminated a prominent militant in Jenin. Simultaneously, attacks were reported on Ali Taher ridge in Lebanon, and Iranian leadership signaled willingness to end the war from a position of strength amid economic pressure. US military posture in Qatar shows dispersed aerial refuelers, possibly indicating precaution against Iranian retaliation.
key_points: IDF Givati Brigade neutralized a terrorist who crossed the yellow line in southern Gaza, posing immediate threat. (Source: @idf_telegram/24947)
IDF Division 99 detained a Hamas terrorist armed with a knife after he crossed the yellow line in central Gaza. (Source: @idf_telegram/24948)
Israeli forces eliminated Fathi Hazem in Jenin, father of the 2022 Dizengoff Street shooter, a known figure in northern Samaria refugee camp battalions. (Source: @inon_yttach/9897)
Multiple sources report attacks on Ali Taher ridge in Lebanon, including a hostile drone dropping a sound bomb on Mansouri town. (Source: @New_security8200/203389, @rasedal3ado138e/386203)
Iranian President Pezeshkian stated Iran must end the war now while in a position of strength with world recognition of victory. (Source: @asafroz/52614)
Iranian Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf warned that military power is insufficient without economic stability, urging non-dollar trade with Iraq to counter US sanctions. (Source: @VahidOnline/77980)
CENTCOM reported US forces facilitated transit of 660 million barrels through Strait of Hormuz since May, but at 7 million bpd, far below pre-war 20 million bpd. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6446)
Satellite imagery shows only three US aerial refueling aircraft dispersed at Al Udeid Air Base in Qatar, suggesting precautions against potential Iranian attack. (Source: @shin_persian/9051)

Simultaneously, attacks were reported on Ali Taher ridge in Lebanon, and Iranian leadership signaled willingness to end the war from a position of strength amid economic pressure. points: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi dismissed latest US economic sanctions as doomed to fail, citing previous failed coercive measures. (Source: @presstv/203704)
President Masoud Pezeshkian declared Iran must end the war now from a position of strength with global recognition of victory, signaling potential diplomatic opening. (Source: @asafroz/52614)

Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf warned that military power cannot sustain the nation if people are hungry and economic growth stalls, calling US sanctions oppressive and urging use of Iranian-Iraqi national currencies in trade to bypass the dollar. (Source: @VahidOnline/77980)

General Wahidi emphasized continuous enhancement of defense industry production under the Defense Ministry and armed forces, with IRGC Commander congratulating acting Defense Minister on Defense Industry Day. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88293)
Defense Ministry spokesperson highlighted speed and production capability as key features, noting battlefield weapons and ammunition are rapidly replaced. (Source: @SharghDaily/179299)

Reports indicate Israeli and US intelligence are scrutinizing imagery for traces of Mojtaba Khamenei during the 40th-day ceremony in Mashhad, with three brothers reportedly visible. (Source: @kianmeli1/90957)
IDF Givati Brigade operating in southern Gaza identified and neutralized a terrorist who crossed the yellow line and approached forces, constituting an immediate threat. (Source: @idf_telegram/24947)
IDF Division 99 in central Gaza monitored and detained a Hamas terrorist armed with a knife after he crossed the yellow line, taking him for field questioning. (Source: @idf_telegram/24948)

Israeli security forces eliminated Fathi Hazem in Jenin, father of Raad Hazem who perpetrated the 2022 Dizengoff Street shooting, a symbolic figure in northern West Bank refugee camp battalions. (Source: @inon_yttach/9897)
Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of evading accountability for war crimes committed in Gaza. (Source: @presstv/203702)
Israeli political figures including Itamar Ben-Gvir face criticism for rising crime rates and international reputational damage, though not directly operational. (Source: @amitsegal/64081)
IDF forces in southern Gaza (Givati Brigade) neutralized a terrorist crossing the yellow line, maintaining deployment per agreement. (Source: @idf_telegram/24947)
IDF Division 99 in central Gaza detained a knife-wielding Hamas operative attempting to cross the yellow line. (Source: @idf_telegram/24948)
In the West Bank, Israeli forces killed Fathi Hazem in Jenin, a prominent figure in Palestinian refugee camp militancy in northern Samaria. (Source: @inon_yttach/9897)
No additional major operations reported in Gaza or West Bank beyond these incidents.
Attacks reported on Ali Taher ridge in Lebanon, with two separate posts confirming strikes. (Source: @New_security8200/203389, @New_security8200/203388)
A hostile drone dropped a sound bomb on the town of Mansouri. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/386203)
Enemy aircraft dropped flares over Ali Taher hill, indicating nocturnal surveillance or targeting activity. (Source: @redlinkleb/37891)
Low-flying drones observed in airspace over Arab Salim, Nabatieh, Ali Taher, and Haboush. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/386240)

Iraqi Prime Minister aims to raise oil production to 8-10 million bpd within six years, seeking increased OPEC export quota and developing exports via Turkey's Ceyhan port as alternative to Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @SharghDaily/179298)
Iraqi Parliament Speaker stated Iranian Shura Council head will discuss exempting Iraq from Strait of Hormuz closure impacts with Iranian leadership. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88287)

CENTCOM confirmed US forces assisted transit of 660 million barrels of crude through Strait of Hormuz since May, aiding 1,300 vessels, but current 7 million bpd rate remains far below pre-war 20 million bpd. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6446)
Analysis suggests US bypasses Hormuz by transferring oil via small ships to Omani and Emirati waters before loading onto larger tankers. (Source: @kianmeli1/90959)

Satellite imagery reveals only three US Air Force aerial refueling aircraft dispersed across Al Udeid Air Base in Qatar, not parked together, possibly as precaution against Iranian attack. (Source: @shin_persian/9051)
UAE has constructed anti-drone defenses around its fuel depots, indicating heightened threat perception. (Source: @kianmeli1/90961)
US sanctions on Iran continue to affect regional economic dynamics, with Iran pushing for non-dollar trade mechanisms. (Source: @presstv/203704, @VahidOnline/77980)

key_developments: IDF neutralized two Palestinian terrorists in Gaza within hours: one in southern Gaza crossing the yellow line, another in central Gaza armed with a knife, demonstrating continued friction along the demarcation line. (Source: @idf_telegram/24947, @idf_telegram/24948)
Israeli forces eliminated Fathi Hazem in Jenin, a senior symbolic figure in northern West Bank militancy, potentially escalating tensions in refugee camp battalions. (Source: @inon_yttach/9897)
Lebanese border area experienced multiple attacks on Ali Taher ridge, including drone-dropped sound bomb on Mansouri and flare deployment, indicating active Israeli aerial operations
